The expanded authorization reflects the Board’s continued focus on disciplined capital management and its commitment to creating long‑term shareholder value, while maintaining the financial flexibility needed to support the Company’s strategic priorities. Repurchases under the program may be made from time to time through open market purchases, privately negotiated transactions, or other methods in compliance with applicable laws and regulations.
